title: Non-Refundable Entry Fee
plainEnglish: Your registration or entry fee will not be returned if the event is cancelled.
counterClause: Entry fees shall be refunded in full if the event is cancelled by the organiser.
negotiationTip: Ask for a refund policy in writing before paying any registration fee.

title: Media Rights Waiver
plainEnglish: The organiser can use your photos and videos for promotional purposes without paying you.
counterClause: Use of participant likeness requires separate written consent and is limited to event promotion.
negotiationTip: Request that media use be limited to the specific event and not sold to third parties.

title: IP Ownership of Submissions
plainEnglish: The organiser may claim ownership of any project or idea you submit at the event.
counterClause: All participant IP remains the property of the participant. The organiser receives no ownership rights.
negotiationTip: Never sign an agreement that transfers ownership of your idea to the organiser.

title: Disqualification Without Appeal
plainEnglish: You can be removed from the competition without explanation and with no right to appeal.
counterClause: Disqualification requires written notice with specific reasons. Participant has 48 hours to respond.
negotiationTip: Request an appeal process be added to the rules before participating.

title: Prize Substitution
plainEnglish: The advertised prize can be replaced with something of lesser value.
counterClause: Prizes shall not be substituted without participant consent. Cash equivalent must be offered.
negotiationTip: Ask for the prize to be listed with a specific cash value in the contract.

title: No Prize Guarantee
plainEnglish: There is no legal obligation to award the prize even if you win.
counterClause: The organiser commits to awarding the advertised prize to the winner as determined by the judging panel.
negotiationTip: Require written confirmation that the prize will be awarded before participating.

title: Liability Waiver
plainEnglish: The organiser is not liable if you are injured or lose property at the event.
counterClause: The organiser shall maintain appropriate insurance and is liable for negligence-related injuries.
negotiationTip: Never sign a blanket liability waiver — ensure it excludes organisational negligence.

title: Cancellation Without Compensation
plainEnglish: The event can be cancelled or postponed and you will not be compensated.
counterClause: If the event is cancelled, all registration fees and documented travel expenses shall be refunded.
negotiationTip: Request a refund policy covering your travel and accommodation costs.

title: Data Collection and Sharing
plainEnglish: Your personal information may be shared with sponsors or third-party partners.
counterClause: Personal data shall not be shared with third parties without explicit written consent.
negotiationTip: Opt out of any marketing communications and data sharing during registration.

title: Rule Changes Without Notice
plainEnglish: The organiser can change competition rules at any time without informing participants.
counterClause: Rule changes require 48 hours written notice to all participants before taking effect.
negotiationTip: Ask for a rule freeze period before the competition begins.

title: Mandatory Arbitration
plainEnglish: You cannot take the organiser to court — disputes must be handled through private arbitration.
counterClause: Either party retains the right to pursue claims in a court of competent jurisdiction.
negotiationTip: Mandatory arbitration favours organisers — try to remove or limit this clause.

title: Indemnification
plainEnglish: You could be held responsible for any legal claims arising from your participation.
counterClause: Indemnification is limited to claims arising directly from the participant's wilful misconduct.
negotiationTip: Request that indemnification be mutual and capped at the registration fee value.

title: Sponsorship Exclusivity
plainEnglish: You may not be allowed to promote or wear competing brands at the event.
counterClause: Exclusivity obligations must be clearly defined and limited to the event duration only.
negotiationTip: Ask for a specific list of prohibited brands before agreeing to exclusivity.

title: Team Ownership Ambiguity
plainEnglish: The contract does not clearly define how IP or prizes are split among team members.
counterClause: IP ownership and prize distribution among team members must be agreed in a separate written agreement.
negotiationTip: Draft a simple team agreement before the event defining ownership and prize splits.

title: Tax Liability for Prize
plainEnglish: You are responsible for paying any taxes on the prize money or goods you receive.
counterClause: The organiser shall provide documentation of prize value for tax reporting purposes.
negotiationTip: Factor in tax obligations when evaluating the real value of the prize.

title: Recording Consent
plainEnglish: The event may be recorded or broadcast live, including footage of you.
counterClause: Participant consents to recording only for event documentation, not for commercial use.
negotiationTip: Clarify whether recordings will be sold, licensed, or used in advertising.

title: Code of Conduct Enforcement
plainEnglish: Violating conduct rules can result in removal from the event without a refund.
counterClause: Conduct violations require a warning before removal, except in cases of serious misconduct.
negotiationTip: Request a copy of the full code of conduct before registering.

title: Participation Fee Forfeiture
plainEnglish: If you withdraw, you lose your participation fee regardless of the reason.
counterClause: Withdrawals made more than 7 days before the event are entitled to a 50% refund.
negotiationTip: Ask about the cancellation window and refund terms before paying.

title: Venue Not Guaranteed
plainEnglish: The event location could change, potentially causing travel and accommodation issues.
counterClause: Venue changes must be communicated at least 14 days in advance with travel cost reimbursement.
negotiationTip: Book refundable travel and accommodation until the venue is confirmed.

title: Minimum Age Restriction
plainEnglish: Participants under 18 may need guardian consent, and failure to comply can void your entry.
counterClause: Age eligibility requirements and guardian consent processes must be clearly communicated upfront.
negotiationTip: Confirm eligibility requirements before investing time in preparation.

title: Winner Announcement Delay
plainEnglish: Results may be delayed indefinitely pending verification by the organiser.
counterClause: Final results shall be announced within 7 days of the event closing.
negotiationTip: Ask for a firm results timeline in the event rules.

title: Consent to Background Check
plainEnglish: Participating means you consent to eligibility verification or background screening.
counterClause: Background checks must comply with applicable data protection laws and be limited to eligibility verification.
negotiationTip: Ask what specific checks are being run and how your data will be used.

title: Governing Law
plainEnglish: Disputes must be resolved under a specific jurisdiction's law, which may not be convenient.
counterClause: Disputes shall be resolved under the laws of the country where the event is held.
negotiationTip: Ensure the governing jurisdiction is where the event physically takes place.

title: Force Majeure
plainEnglish: The organiser has no obligation to compensate you if extraordinary events disrupt the event.
counterClause: Force majeure events entitle participants to a full refund of registration fees.
negotiationTip: Ensure force majeure covers refunds, not just suspension of obligations.

title: Entire Agreement Clause
plainEnglish: Only the written terms apply — verbal promises from organisers are not enforceable.
counterClause: All material commitments made during the registration process must be documented in this agreement.
negotiationTip: Get every important promise in writing before registering.
